newsitem.title: USA: NBC, CBS reject ads with ABC star - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: NBC, CBS reject ads with ABC star - WSJ.

text.p: NBC and CBS are refusing to run an ad for General Motor's Cadillac that includes a star from ABC's television drama, "NYPD Blue," the Wall Street Journal reported Friday.

The report said the commercials feature actor Dennis Franz, who plays Detective Andy Sipowicz on the series about New York City cops, as an officer who detains a Mercedes driver for "driving a luxury car without enough horsepower."
CBS, which is a unit of Westinghouse, and NBC, a General Electric unit, say they do not want to run an ad that promotes a show by rival network ABC, the report said.
GE "prohibits direct or indirect promotion of a programme or an event featured on competing media," an NBC spokeswoman told the paper.
